text: Hi Joan, we reviewed your screenshot. The run stopped during a service step; it does not show that you cancelled it. We have prepared an update with a shorter wait and a clearer message so you can resume. This needs Chrome Web Store release as version 0.10.36 before it reaches you. We are still checking the original interruption. Once you have that version, please try again and reply here if it stops, with the time and a screenshot.

Hi Vinod, your screenshot helped us find a problem: Scout treated this person as already connected even though LinkedIn showed otherwise. We have corrected that check in version 0.10.36, which still needs Chrome Web Store release. After you receive that version, please retry and let us know whether requests continue. Do not resend requests that are already pending. We are keeping this report under investigation until you confirm.

Hi Vinod, both screenshots show posts shared from other people, and one is in French. Scout currently comments only on eligible recent original English posts, so these examples are skipped intentionally. We have also improved the record of why a comment was skipped to help investigate other cases. Please send a screenshot and profile link where the prospect has a recent original English post but no comment is left. Your wider report remains under investigation.

Hi Jacoba, the screenshot shows the run stopped at a service step. The message was too vague to explain what happened, and we have not yet confirmed the exact cause of that interruption. Version 0.10.36 adds a clearer message and a shorter wait before pausing for you to resume. It still needs Chrome Web Store release. After it reaches you, please retry and reply with the time and screenshot if the problem returns.

Hi Jacoba, we found repeated waits while profiles and posts loaded, plus leads skipped by the English-language checks. That helps explain why many leads were checked but few requests were sent. We also found that one writing step could wait too long; version 0.10.36 shortens that wait and pauses with a clearer message. It still needs Chrome Web Store release. This does not yet confirm that all delays are fixed. After updating, please tell us which profile stalls and for how long.

Hi Apple, your screenshot shows a service step failed after progress had already been made. We found a waiting step that could keep Scout on one profile too long. Version 0.10.36 adds a shorter wait and a clearer pause message, but it still needs Chrome Web Store release. We have not yet confirmed the original interruption is fully fixed. After that version reaches you, please retry and reply with the time and screenshot if it stops again.
